en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large, neoclassical building with a prominent clock tower and arched windows, located on the bank of a river. The building is connected to a multi-arched stone bridge with people walking across it. In the background, there are hills and early 20th-century urban buildings. The bottom of the postcard contains text in Cyrillic and Latin letters.
